crossRefs.note: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

parallels.note: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

translations.web: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.
translations.bsb: and the third married the widow, and in the same way all seven died, leaving no children.
translations.kjv: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
translations.asv: and the third took her; and likewise the seven also left no children, and died.
